"'''Scrapping for a Song / Bell and the Band'''" is the fourth episode of the [[Young Jedi Adventures Season Three|third season]] of the animated series ''[[Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures]]''. It was released on [[Disney+]] on [[December 8]], [[2025]].

==Official description==
''The Jedi find a gift. Kai and Bell must rescue Ember.''
